newsitem.title: DUBAI: Jebel Ali Free Zone 1996 imports up at $3.18 bln.
newsitem.headline: Jebel Ali Free Zone 1996 imports up at $3.18 bln.

text.p: Imports into Dubai's Jebel Ali Free Zone rose to $3.18 billion in 1996 from $3.10 billion in 1995, the free zone authority said on Tuesday.
In a statement, it said firms in the zone exported goods worth $3.26 billion in 1996, up from $3.24 billion the previous year.
During 1995 investment in the free zone, which hosts 930 companies from 72 countries, reached $1.6 billion. No 1996 figures have been made available.
Dubai is an important regional distribution and re-export hub.
